title: Rarity weights
description: Global default distribution of item-drop rarities. Per-NPC overrides live on the NPC pub via the rarity_override field. The four numbers should sum to 1.0 (the server normalizes if not, but designer intent is clearer with weights that already sum cleanly).

common.title: Common
common.description: Probability of a common drop. Common drops carry 1 mod (per the per-tier mod count).

rare.title: Rare
rare.description: Probability of a rare drop. Rare drops carry 2 mods.

epic.title: Epic
epic.description: Probability of an epic drop. Epic drops carry 3 mods and unlock the conditional mod pool (Berserker, Predator, Slayer).

legendary.title: Legendary
legendary.description: Probability of a legendary drop. Legendary drops carry 4 mods.
